sources.title: Afghanistan: passports and visas
sources.publisher: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Denmark
sources.officialityEvidence: Denmark's live Foreign Ministry passport-and-visa page is expressly for Danish citizens travelling on Danish national passports for tourism and was updated 24 July 2026.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Der er visumpligt for indrejse i Afghanistan.

sources.title: Central African Republic: passports and visas
sources.publisher: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Denmark
sources.officialityEvidence: Denmark's live passport-and-visa guidance is scoped to Danish national-passport tourism and was updated 6 June 2026. It expressly says it has no further Danish entry-rule information.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Vi har ikke yderligere oplysninger om visumregler for danskeres indrejse.

sources.title: Chad: passports and visas
sources.publisher: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Denmark
sources.officialityEvidence: Denmark's live passport-and-visa guidance is scoped to Danish national-passport tourism and was updated 6 June 2026. It confirms the visa requirement and embassy application route.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Visumpligt. Du kan søge om visum hos Tchads ambassade.

sources.title: Iran: passports and visas
sources.publisher: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Denmark
sources.officialityEvidence: Denmark's live passport-and-visa guidance says Iran supplied rules for Danish citizens on Danish national passports and was updated 4 June 2026. It describes online, mission and airport variants without one unconditional issuance baseline.
sources.supportingExcerpt: prisen afhænger af om det er udstedt online, på ambassaden eller i lufthavnen ved ankomst

sources.title: Iraq: passports and visas
sources.publisher: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Denmark
sources.officialityEvidence: Denmark's live passport-and-visa guidance is scoped to Danish national-passport tourism and was updated 25 May 2026. It separates federal Iraq from Kurdistan Regional Iraq and only describes online applications.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Indrejsekravene varierer delvist mellem det føderale Irak og Kurdistan-regionen.

sources.title: Palestinian Territory: passports and visas
sources.publisher: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Denmark
sources.officialityEvidence: Denmark's live destination-specific passport-and-visa page was updated 19 May 2026. It says Palestinian authorities do not issue visitor visas and that Israel controls most entry and exit routes.
sources.supportingExcerpt: de palæstinensiske myndigheder ikke selv visum ... Ind- og udrejse ... kontrolleres ... af Israel.

policies.title: Danish ordinary passports: Chad advance visitor visa
policies.summary: Denmark's current passport-and-visa guidance requires a visa and directs Danish national-passport applicants to apply through Chad's embassy.
conditions: This records ordinary Danish national-passport tourism only and requires application through a Chadian embassy before travel.
Purpose, passport, health, document, carrier, security and final-admission requirements remain applicable.
